## Problem and behavior

Describe the business requirement and observable result. Link the BL task and GitHub issue.

## Scope

- Business rules / acceptance criteria:
- API contract and Swagger:
- Database migrations / rollback or forward recovery:

## Validation

List exact commands and actual results. Distinguish passed, failed, and not run.

## Review

- [ ] Tests cover relevant success, failure and financial invariants
- [ ] Swagger describes request/response, status codes and business errors
- [ ] No credentials or real customer data
- [ ] Migration and operational risks described
- [ ] Human reviewer reviewed each commit and resolved comments

Only the human owner decides approval and merge.
